scripts.test: node --import tsx --test tests/config.test.ts tests/cache.test.ts tests/gate.test.ts tests/xapi.test.ts tests/log.test.ts tests/tools.test.ts tests/consolidate.test.ts tests/enabled_tools.test.ts tests/billing.test.ts
